speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Automating the gateway routing is a start, but it leaves the service itself unmonitored during the morning window. I need continuous health checks that alert us before the first store manager tries to load their order.
output.correction: You are reading my deployment proposal as a general reliability ask, but I am only talking about the serving layer. I am not asking for model retraining changes, just for the API to prove it is alive before the order window opens.
